items.summary: The Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission has notified draft Multi-Year Tariff Distribution Regulations, 2026, establishing a five-year framework from April 1, 2027. MPERC proposes a 70:30 debt-equity ratio with a 15% base Return on Equity, offering extra incentives for efficient capital and maintenance spending. The draft also introduces specific targets for reducing Aggregate Technical and Commercial losses, sharing variances between utilities and consumers in a 1:2 ratio. Additionally, the regulations retain the automatic monthly Fuel and Power Purchase Adjustment Surcharge mechanism while strengthening consumer protection measures against overcharging.

items.summary: Residents of Gary, Indiana, faced extended power outages lasting up to two weeks following recent storms, a situation that local leaders say could have been mitigated by canceled federal solar funding. items.summary: Virginia has become the first state to launch a statewide bulk-purchasing campaign for rooftop solar, aiming to reduce installation costs for residents. The initiative, called Switch Together, is run by the nonprofit Solar United Neighbors and supported by Governor Abigail Spanberger's office. By pooling demand, trusted installers can secure equipment discounts of 20% to 30% for participants. The program currently covers 100 counties, excluding only the extreme southwest region due to vetting timelines. Early results show over 4,300 sign-ups and 120 contracts, with expectations to reach 500 contracts by October 15. The campaign also offers access to cheaper home batteries and EV chargers. Officials note that the model could serve as a roadmap for other states facing rising electricity rates.
items.title: Virginia launches first bulk-buy solar program to lower costs

key_points: A review of 2022 through 2025 milestones shows hydrogen media coverage vastly outpaces its physical market deployment.
China operated approximately 366,000 electric heavy trucks while only about 18,000 fuel-cell heavy trucks were in service.
Battery events averaged a higher stage on a commercialization ladder compared to hydrogen events in the normalized four-year sample.
The authors argue that news focuses on discrete events while markets grow through routine purchases that generate fewer stories.
items.summary: An analysis of energy transition news from 2022 through 2025 reveals that hydrogen receives significantly more media attention than its physical deployment justifies. While battery announcements outnumbered hydrogen ones by a ratio of 206 to 114, the actual market gap is far wider when measured by operating vehicles and storage capacity. For instance, China operated roughly 366,000 electric heavy trucks compared to only 18,000 fuel-cell units at the end of 2025. The authors explain that news focuses on discrete events, whereas markets grow through routine purchases that generate fewer stories. Consequently, hydrogen projects appear more prominent than their commercial maturity suggests, with battery events averaging a higher stage on a commercialization ladder. The full TFIE Strategy Briefing analysis provides specific evidence checks to help analysts distinguish genuine market formation from publicity-driven narratives.
items.title: Analysis Shows Hydrogen Media Attention Exceeds Actual Market Deployment

items.summary: The Delhi Tamil Advocates Association has written to the Chief Justice of India and the Government of India seeking immediate assistance to locate former Madras High Court judge Justice Veerasamy Sivagnanam. While the death toll in Nepal rose to 788, 320 Indians remain missing as of August 31, 2026.
